title: Exclude two fixed-endpoint upstream payload recodes at BIT chart 388
body:
## Change and scope

Screened all 2,016 chronological pairs among 64 named earlier MOVE sites. Ten can recover u1 with the 14 source histories pooled for free. All ten leave chart-560 stock disjoint from the three original target rows, excluding a solution with one arrival from each of charts 560, 283 and 311. The selected witness rewrites fail separate first-reader and public-output checks.

## Source and overlap

Uses #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and extends the single-ingress work in #7884 to two payload edits, including first-to-second influence.

## Validation and credit

The four offline commands in README passed in a relocated copy, including an independent low-pivot and forward impulse audit and four corruption controls. Source and receipts are hashed. Thanks to the #7830 contributors. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Additional old rewrites, new paid arrivals, changed source charts and relaxed exit obligations remain open.
